comparison.objective: Lower a bent tube level so four legs enter checking-fixture slots simultaneously; candidate removes a terminal from a connector.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests symmetric bimanual support, pose leveling, and simultaneous multi-slot insertion. Candidate tests fine tool guidance, latch depression, regrasping, and opposed withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires all four legs seated to clearance tolerances, released, at rest, and held 1 s. Candidate requires one terminal extracted without collateral release or damage and stable for 3 s.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous fixture seating tests multi-point alignment, not latch-mediated selective extraction.
